name: Spire Apex Lancers
description: The Lancers are Axiom Corporation's flagship IRONWALL LEAGUE franchise, assembled in 2214 as a direct competitive response to HelixCorp's dominance of the league's upper tier. Fielded from the Spire Apex Arena — a purpose-built venue in the lower Spire with variable-gravity field segments — the Lancers roster is composed entirely of Tier 4-5 contracted athletes carrying Axiom's latest Sovereign-series chrome. Their 2221 IRONWALL LEAGUE championship was the most-watched neural-stream sporting event in GLMZ history, pulling 4.2 million concurrent feeds.
story_hooks: A disgruntled Axiom chrome technician leaks the experimental augmentation files to an underground journalist, triggering a chase across three tiers of the city.

A Shelf-born fan who has followed the Lancers obsessively since childhood wins a contest to spend a day with the team — and witnesses something in the Spire Apex Arena that they were never supposed to see.
A rival corponation hires a fixer to recruit a key Lancers player mid-season, and the player's contract contains a termination clause that amounts to a death sentence.
